userStories.title: Add viewer limits, cursors, media detection, and text page boundaries
userStories.description: As an operator, I want bounded first paint cutoffs, opaque version-bound cursors, media classification, and UTF-8 safe text page boundaries, so that opening large changed files does not freeze the viewer or split multi-byte characters.
acceptanceCriteria: Create RED tests in packages/git/src/viewer-limits.test.ts, implement packages/git/src/viewer-limits.ts, and make focused tests and git package type-check pass.

Define seven locked cutoff constants: VIEWER_FIRST_PAINT_BYTES (256 KiB), VIEWER_FIRST_PAINT_LINES (2000), VIEWER_STREAM_BYTES (1 MiB), VIEWER_DOWNLOAD_ONLY_BYTES (50 MiB), VIEWER_HEX_PEEK_BYTES (4 KiB), VIEWER_BINARY_PROBE_BYTES (8 KiB), and VIEWER_DIFF_CONTEXT_LINES (3).
Implement encodeViewerCursor and decodeViewerCursor with unpadded base64url JSON; enforce route-specific axes ('o' for offset, 'h' for hunk) and 64-hex version string.
Distinguish malformed/invalid cursors (ViewerCursorError { code: 'invalid' }) from stale cursors (ViewerCursorError { code: 'stale' }); an empty cursor decodes to 0.
sliceTextPage stops after 2,000 newline-terminated lines or at most 256 KiB plus boundary bytes; never splits a UTF-8 code point, and short final pages return full bytes with truncated: false.

chooseGitFilePresentation classifies files above 50 MiB as download without probing; sniffs PNG, JPEG, GIF87a/89a, WEBP, and SVG (with BOM or XML declaration) as image before the NUL heuristic; classifies remaining NUL in first 8 KiB as hex; and all others as text.

userStories.title: Make file views bounded and downloads abortable streams
userStories.description: As an operator, I want worktree and tree file reads to respect viewer cutoffs and download requests to stream, so that large files and downloads do not buffer entirely in server memory.
acceptanceCriteria: Add failing real-file and real-blob tests in packages/git/src/file-read.test.ts, implement packages/git/src/git-stream.ts, update packages/git/src/file-read.ts and packages/git/src/index.ts, and pass focused tests and git type check.

Implement internal git-stream.ts spawning git with argv arrays, providing streamGitStdout (abortable ReadableStream<Uint8Array>) and readGitStdoutWindow (collecting up to takeBytes after skipping skipBytes and terminating the child).
Worktree reads check bigint lstat, contain the path, open the file, and re-verify dev, ino, mode, size, mtimeNs, ctimeNs on the handle before returning a reader; symlinks return link target bytes.
Tree reads inspect size first with cat-file -s, avoid whole-blob buffering, and use spawned helpers for bounded windows and streams; no HEAD:path or shell exec.

fileAt accepts FileAtRequest with intent: 'full' | 'view' | 'download': full returns all bytes for backwards compatibility; view returns at most 256 KiB/2000 lines for text, at most 4 KiB for hex, all bytes for images <= 1 MiB, stream for images > 1 MiB, and metadata only for files > 50 MiB; download returns delivery: 'stream' from byte zero without accepting a cursor.
Opaque text cursors (axis 'o') are validated against contentHash; stale files throw GitFileError { code: 'stale_cursor' }, and malformed cursors throw GitFileError { code: 'invalid_cursor' }.

Export expanded types (FileAtRequest, FileAtResult, FileAtBytesResult, FileAtStreamResult, FileAtIntent, GitFilePresentation) from packages/git/src/index.ts without exporting new runtime I/O functions.

userStories.title: Parse and page Now diffs without buffering the whole diff
userStories.description: As an operator, I want modified file diffs parsed incrementally and paged with hunk cursors, so that large diffs do not exceed Node buffer limits and special modified files fall back to raw view.
acceptanceCriteria: Create failing pure parser/accumulator tests in packages/git/src/diff-page.test.ts and real-git tests in packages/git/src/file-read.test.ts; implement packages/git/src/diff-page.ts and update file-read.ts; pass all git tests.
Implement visitUnifiedDiffChunks and parseUnifiedDiffChunks streaming UTF-8 chunks across multibyte line boundaries without losing context or lines.

Implement HunkPageAccumulator to accumulate diff hunks up to 262,144 serialized JSON bytes or 2,000 changes; keep an oversized first hunk whole; signal page_full before a later hunk that would exceed limits.

fileDiff inspects both worktree and HEAD with bounded probes; if either side is image, hex, or download (>50 MiB), returns hunks: [], fileFallback: true, and binary set according to whether NUL was present.

For text diffs, spawn git diff with argv ['--no-optional-locks', '--literal-pathspecs', 'diff', '--no-color', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-textconv', '--text', '-U3', 'HEAD', '--', path] and feed stdout incrementally into accumulator.
Kill the diff child process immediately upon page_full or abort signal; encode next hunk index into opaque cursor (axis 'h') with version hash derived from both sides.
Reject stale hunk cursors with GitFileError { code: 'stale_cursor' } and malformed cursors with GitFileError { code: 'invalid_cursor' }.

userStories.title: Serialize cursors, fallbacks, and streams at the HTTP boundary
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the server diff and raw file routes to serialize presentation headers, stream bodies, and map cursor staleness, so that web clients receive bounded responses with accurate metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Update packages/server/src/routes/api.git-changes.test.ts with failing boundary tests; implement changes in packages/server/src/routes/schemas/git.schemas.ts, diff-route.ts, diff-handler.ts, and file-handler.ts; pass isolated HTTP tests.
Add fileFallback: z.boolean() to gitReadyDiffResponseSchema; add 409 errorSchema response to gitDiffRoute.

diff-handler forwards cursor and request abort signal to fileDiff; maps invalid_cursor to HTTP 400 ({ error: 'Invalid file cursor' }) and stale_cursor to HTTP 409 ({ error: 'File changed' }) without logging cursor content; logs use stable error types.
file-handler calls fileAt with intent: 'download' only when download=1 query param is present; otherwise calls with intent: 'view' and optional cursor; forwards cancellation signal.

Stream bodies are returned directly via Web Stream; download=1 sets Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="download" and Content-Length: full_size; non-download hex views return bytes without attachment disposition.

Successful raw responses return quoted 64-hex ETag and presentation headers: X-Archon-Git-Byte-Length, X-Archon-Git-Truncated, X-Archon-Git-Cursor, X-Archon-Git-Presentation, X-Archon-Git-Media-Type; CAP-6 responses omit these presentation headers.
Regenerate packages/web/src/lib/api.generated.d.ts using bun --filter @archon/web generate:types and verify fileFallback and 409 response appear in the generated types.

userStories.title: Parse raw presentations in the web API client
userStories.description: As a web component, I want the web API client to parse presentation headers into a discriminated GitFileClientResult union and support cursor-based paging, so that the viewer can handle text, image, hex, and download modes cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Write failing client tests in packages/web/src/lib/api.git-changes.test.ts; update packages/web/src/lib/api.ts; pass client tests and web type-check.
Update gitFileUrl to accept cursor and download options, outputting query params only when non-empty, preserving per-segment path encoding.

getWorkflowRunGitFile parses and validates response headers into GitFileClientResult: text (text, contentHash, truncated, cursor, byteLength), image (bytes, contentHash, mediaType, byteLength), hex (bytes, contentHash, byteLength), download (contentHash, byteLength), or empty (emptyReason).
Use response.text() only for text presentations; use response.arrayBuffer() for image and hex; cancel response.body without reading for download-only presentations.
Validate presentation headers: require non-empty cursor exactly when text is truncated; reject inconsistent headers with Invalid git file response.
Maintain backwards fallback for responses missing presentation headers (JSON CAP-6, text as untruncated final page, octet-stream as download-only).

userStories.title: Render hex, images, Load more, and virtualized hunks
userStories.description: As an operator, I want safe inline image rendering, a formatted hex peek, virtualized diff hunks, and a Load more control, so that large diffs and non-text files render smoothly without DOM bloat or XSS risks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create hex-peek.ts and hex-peek.test.ts implementing formatHexPeek (16 bytes per row: 8-digit lowercase hex offset, two-space gap, 47-char padded hex bytes, two-space gap, 16-char printable ASCII bounded by vertical bars).
Create inline-image.tsx and inline-image.test.tsx managing URL.createObjectURL and URL.revokeObjectURL on byte change and unmount; render images via without DOM injection or syntax highlighting.

Create virtualized-diff.tsx with independent Before and After virtualized panes using @tanstack/react-virtual with initialRect: { width: 0, height: 280 }, estimating row height from change count and rendering .sc-virtual-hunk wrappers.

Update file-viewer.tsx and file-viewer.test.tsx: handle text, diff, image, hex, download states; render Load more for truncated text or diff states with non-empty cursor; render Cancel button when loadingMore or initial loading.

Create and run packages/web/src/component-integration/source-control-large-diff-spike.tsx: verify 2+ MiB diff renders in <1000 ms in happy-dom, virtualizes hunks (mounted < total), and bundles lodash input bytes > 0.

userStories.title: Append pages without losing cancellation or frozen Reload behavior
userStories.description: As an operator, I want clicking Load more to append text or diff hunks without changing the frozen changes list or causing false staleness, and I want page cancellation separate from closing the viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Add failing mounted tests in packages/web/src/component-integration/source-control-tab.test.tsx; update packages/web/src/components/workflows/source-control/source-control-tab.tsx; pass mounted tab tests.
For modified (M) files, route to raw worktree fetch when diffResponse.fileFallback is true; route download links to gitFileUrl(..., { download: true }).

Maintain stable reloadFingerprint: for truncated diffs, use first cursor; for complete diffs, use JSON of first response; preserve fingerprint across appended pages so accumulating hunks does not trigger Changed on disk — Reload.

Implement onLoadMore in tab: validate selected file, request next page with opaque cursor, require identical contentHash (text) or matching metadata (diff), append text/hunks, and update cursor/truncated.
Distinguish cancellation: Cancel during initial file open closes the viewer; Cancel during Load more aborts only that page's in-flight request and keeps painted content visible.
When Load more receives HTTP 409 (File changed), keep currently painted content, clear loadingMore, and trigger the existing manual Changed on disk — Reload comparison.
Verify .env still opens as ordinary highlighted text without denylist/redaction (NFR6).
